form_name: MILESTONE TREND ANALYSIS AND SLIP CHART
_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'MILESTONE TREND ANALYSIS AND SLIP CHART' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-06.14.

f01_Milestone_Identifier_and_Baseline_Ta.label: Milestone Identifier and Baseline Target Date
f01_Milestone_Identifier_and_Baseline_Ta.guidance: Milestone code, deliverable name, and original approved baseline completion date.

f02_Historical_Forecast_Trend_Data_Point.label: Historical Forecast Trend Data Points
f02_Historical_Forecast_Trend_Data_Point.guidance: Bi-weekly or monthly sequential forecasts tracking milestone date movements over time.

f03_Current_Variance_and_Slip_Days_Calcu.label: Current Variance and Slip Days Calculated
f03_Current_Variance_and_Slip_Days_Calcu.guidance: Net difference in working days between current forecast and baseline date.

f04_Root_Cause_of_Schedule_Drift_and_Dep.label: Root Cause of Schedule Drift and Dependencies
f04_Root_Cause_of_Schedule_Drift_and_Dep.guidance: Underlying drivers (supplier delay, scope change, technical hurdles) causing milestone slippage.

f05_Schedule_Recovery_Actions_and_Target.label: Schedule Recovery Actions and Target Stabilization
f05_Schedule_Recovery_Actions_and_Target.guidance: Crashing, fast-tracking, or resource reallocations committed to recover milestone timing.
